Înțeleg că nu sunteți de acord cu decizia privind zgârietura. Vă pun în legătură cu un coleg, care va prelua discuția.

input.summary: Customer (email ada.blymere@example.com, order SC-2308) disputes the decision on their existing damage claim. They reported a raised scratch across the ink on the print; the earlier reply said it was part of the artwork. They want that decision reviewed.
